stories.title: Met Office amber heat warning covers Deeside from Wednesday as temperatures forecast to near Welsh record
stories.summary: A Met Office amber extreme heat warning is in place for Deeside from Wednesday midnight through to Thursday night, only the second time North Wales has been placed under one. stories.title: Mold Carnival returns to Maes Bodlonfa Fields on Sunday 5 July with free entry
stories.summary: Mold Carnival returns to Maes Bodlonfa Fields on Sunday 5 July, with free entry and a programme running from 11am to 6pm. stories.title: Chester Haematology Centre to open at Countess of Chester Hospital in late July
stories.summary: A new dedicated centre for blood cancer patients is due to open at the Countess of Chester Hospital in late July, with north Wales patients among those who will use it. stories.title: Jade Jones Pavilion launches free monthly coffee morning open to all in Flint
stories.summary: A monthly coffee morning is launching at Jade Jones Pavilion in Flint next week, open to anyone who wants to come in for a chat with no booking needed.
